personality_one_liner: A stark, highly functional, engineering-focused interface that prioritizes technical clarity, rigid grids, and structured inquiry workflows over soft aesthetics.

spacing.rule: Use visible spacing systems and rigid grids. Edge-to-edge sections with thick structural dividers. Zero soft padding without purpose.

dont's: Do not use glass or blur anywhere. It clashes with the brutalist industrial aesthetic.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Showcase corporate identity, media library, and manufacturing capabilities with industrial starkness.

states.error: Mono-spaced error block with 'RETRY CONNECTION' hard button

screens.layout: Rigid edge-to-edge layout. Start with a hero image (factory/smelting) with a dark gradient scrim and oversized Archivo headlines. Below, use a modular grid for 'Enterprise Media & Video Library' featuring edge-to-edge thumbnail cards with a sharp play icon. Section headers should be heavy, bordered, and use uppercase mono fonts.

screens.name: Catalogue
screens.purpose: A structured B2B inventory for valves and castings, optimized for technical comparison and RFQ workflows.

states.empty: Stark mono text: 'NO PRODUCTS FOUND MATCHING CRITERIA' + Reset Filter CTA

screens.layout: Category-led discovery with a sticky filter bar at the top (solid surface bg, 1pt bottom border). Product cards should be sharp rectangles (0 radius), displaying high-contrast imagery, SKU in mono, and a prominent 'Add to Inquiry' button. Detail pages use progressive disclosure via bottom sheets for specs, CAD files, and certificates.

screens.name: Portal
screens.purpose: Customer login and dashboard to track submitted RFQs, download certs, and view history.

states.empty: Icon: Phosphor FileText (sharp outline). 'NO ACTIVE RFQS'. Action: 'BROWSE CATALOGUE'

screens.layout: Login uses single-column edge-to-edge inputs with `borderStrong` outlines on focus. The dashboard features a table-like view of RFQs using thick structural dividers (`surfaceTertiary`), mono text for Tracking IDs, and stark status tags (success/warning colors in sharp rectangles). High information density.

screens.name: Assistant
screens.purpose: AI Knowledge Assistant for technical spec lookup and catalogue queries.

states.empty: Stark welcome screen with suggested mono technical queries.

screens.layout: Chat interface with sharp rectangular message bubbles. Mono timestamps aligned right. Input field pinned to the bottom (above keyboard) with a rigid 1pt top border and solid background. The AI persona should feel like a technical command-line interface rather than a friendly avatar.

hero_smelting.alt: Molten metal pouring from ladle in industrial foundry

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Brutalist Mobile personality. Zero border-radius across the entire application (buttons, inputs, cards, sheets all must have 0 radius).
Do NOT use any blue, purple, or indigo hues. The palette is restricted to stark greys, blacks, paper whites, and a single Molten Orange brand color (#E65C00) to represent heavy industry/casting.
Rely heavily on the IBM Plex Mono font for all metadata, SKUs, RFQ tracking IDs, timestamps, and buttons. Archivo is reserved for large structural headers.
Implement layout using rigid grids, thick structural dividers (1pt borders), and edge-to-edge containers. Do not use soft shadows or glassmorphism anywhere.
For the RFQ/Inquiry flow, build it as a sticky primary CTA at the bottom of the catalogue detail pages, keeping it visible over scrolling technical specs.
When a company logo is required, fallback to rendering the initials 'TC' in a stark, brand-tinted square container using the mono font.
Ensure all images used as backgrounds (e.g., hero covers) have a strict gradient scrim (top-down transparent to surfaceInverse) so overlaid text remains completely legible.
